verdict.rationale: The evidence shows official multi-language developer tooling: the open-source AWS CDK framework supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, C#/.Net, and Go, with a construct library. Programmatic access is also documented through the Cost Explorer API and the CLI. However, the pack never mentions the general-purpose AWS service SDKs for calling services from application code, so the story is only indirectly supported through infrastructure-as-code tooling. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official per-language AWS service SDKs, SDK coverage and versioning details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
